[issue by goldswim]
### Describe the bug

Hello,

Version: Minecraft 1.21.1

NeoForge 21.1.234
Applied Energistics 2 19.2.17
ExpandedAE 2.1.1
ExtendedAE 2.2.33
AdvancedAE 1.6.11

Here's the log causing the disconnect:

Screen is missing required image: toolbox
at appeng.client.gui.implementations.PatternProviderScreen.handler$jal000$expandedae$init

### How to reproduce the bug

it happens when i try to access any pattern provider's UI by right-clicking it.

### Expected behavior

Display pattern provider's UI

### Additional details

_No response_

### Which minecraft version are you using?

1.21

### On which mod loaders does it happen?

NeoForge
